entries.title: Psalms 137:1
segments: ¶By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down; yea, we wept when we remembered Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 137:2
segments: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 137:3
segments: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that made us wail [required] mirth, [saying,] Sing us [one] of the songs of Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 137:4
segments: How should we sing a song of Jehovah's upon a foreign soil?

entries.title: Psalms 137:5
segments: If I forget thee, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget [its skill];

entries.title: Psalms 137:6
segments: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to my palate: if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

entries.title: Psalms 137:7
segments: ¶Remember, O Jehovah, against the sons of Edom, the day of Jerusalem; who said, Lay [it] bare, Lay [it] bare, down to its foundation!

entries.title: Psalms 137:8
segments: Daughter of Babylon, who art to be laid waste, happy he that rendereth unto thee that which thou hast meted out to us.

entries.title: Psalms 137:9
segments: Happy he that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the rock.
